button.$description: Express shared action emphasis, size and button states.

app.caelos.note: All three emphasis styles expose Default, Hover, Pressed, Success, Focus and Disabled. Hover and Focus share blue foreground and soft glow. Tonal uses a translucent violet/sage wash, then the shared glass material when pressed. Text stays unfilled and glows around its glyphs. Geometry uses lower-tier tokens; full component and production host wiring remain open.
app.caelos.constructionPolicy: Construction and state appearances select shared definitions. Those definitions reference lower-tier tokens directly. Remaining button leaves are runtime compatibility exports, not extra visual parameters.

feedbackPolicy.principle: Every user action must provide visual feedback.
feedbackPolicy.pressed: Immediate acknowledgement while a control is being activated; never waits for an operation result. Tonal and Text use Ready Blue without glow; Text adds an underline. The same visible feedback applies with reduced motion. Primary is unchanged.
feedbackPolicy.success: Optional confirmation after an operation actually succeeds and its result is not immediately visible, such as saving, sending, or generating a script in the background. Never infer success from a click or a timer.
feedbackPolicy.visibleOutcome: Opening a menu, dialog, or destination page is already visual feedback and does not require a Success button state.
feedbackPolicy.hoverAndFocus: Share the same appearance; retain separate pointer-hover and keyboard-focus behavior. Pressed remains distinct during activation.
feedbackPolicy.reset: Return to default when the next edit or next eligible action is reported by the host; never reset on a timer or by clicking Success.
feedbackPolicy.pending: Wait for the real operation result. A stale completion must not mark newer edits as saved.
feedbackPolicy.failure: Show an error with retry; never show Success after failure.
feedbackPolicy.implementation: createActionFeedback() manages result and revision state; the host supplies edits, completion, eligibility, visible pending/error feedback, and accessible announcements. No production consumer is wired by this catalog change.

surfacePolicy.description: 135-degree ready/sage wash and centered soft glow. Reuses the Cloud ingredients; all layers follow the host medium radius. Success keeps the plain sage tint to preserve cream-text contrast. No hard border. This is a current-token adaptation of the recovered surface, not a verified match to the deployed console.

tonalSurfacePolicy.description: Default/Hover/Focus use the Cloud body and violet/sage wash. Pressed uses Ready Blue foreground without glow and composes the complete unified glass finish, including 125% saturation, overlap input and opaque fallback. Success uses sage-green text over the translucent body with a quiet sage wash. Disabled uses the shared opaque disabled bed. No hard border.
tonalSurfacePolicy.reference: Caelos_staging packages/ui/src/recipes.ts at be3aec0ccf597141020bea35e6f4cbb3b982a012: tonal violet/sage gradient; the current-token glass pressed state follows Daniel’s request, not a claimed deployed-console match.
tonalSurfacePolicy.figmaLimit: Gradient alpha/geometry are sync-derived. Figma background blur previews glass; CSS saturation, overlap response and reduced-transparency fallback require runtime verification.

app.caelos.textSurfacePolicy: No surface fill in any state. Hover and Focus use blue glyphs and a soft glyph glow using the existing 50% opacity token; Pressed uses Ready Blue with an underline and no glow. Success is ✓ Success in sage green, with no fill. Same real-result/reset contract as Primary.

chip.$description: Compact interactive filter/menu and toggle controls. Passive labels belong to badges.

app.caelos.note: Interactive only. Filter-menu opens options; toggle changes one value directly. Pressed acknowledges activation or an open menu, not successful completion. No Success state. Applied filter summary is host-owned and distinct from menu-open state. Dark v1; static Figma review, runtime menu/keyboard wiring remains open. Pressed uses Ready Blue on the shared glass surface without glow, including reduced motion.

reference.finding: Filter & sort uses the small tonal Button. The chip class is the requested design-system classification; its cloud and glass parameters reuse current primitives rather than historical raw values.

initials-size.$description: Initials font size by avatar frame size. XL uses the reviewed 18px step. XXL uses the 20px step derived from the original proportional sizing, pending visual review.

badge.$description: Passive status, count and category information; shape and semantic tone are independent.

app.caelos.note: One passive information recipe with independent shape and reusable colour choices. Planning, In progress, Complete and Blocked are example content, not separate recipes or interaction states. No hover, focus, pressed or tab stop. Former noninteractive status/count/category chips belong here. Avatars retain their identity-specific recipe while badges share their tinted-wash visual language. Dark v1 review; runtime component export remains open.

delivery-status.label: Delivery status badge
delivery-status.description: Passive chat delivery information; uses the badge tone and shape choices, not a separate control family.
delivery-status.note: State-to-label/tone mapping and host wiring remain to be audited. No interactive states.

app.caelos.materialConstruction: Shared glass body, tint and blur with a diagonal wash from the selected tone to Structural Violet. tonePaints selects label ink, washStart and glowInk together. All shapes use the existing soft glow blur and opacity with zero offset and spread. No stroke or hard outline. Background saturation is 125% in the shared material contract; Figma cannot preview saturation or adaptive overlap. Gradient and glow colour alpha are catalog-derived; resync after token changes. Reduced-transparency fallback and host behavior await runtime implementation.
